meta.title: Deflection
meta.description: Changing the way one thinks is not an instantaneous process. Only when the heart is moved do people realize the flaws in the views they have taken for granted.

units.rawText: The day after, the Admin Center.

units.displayText: De Lacey sat at the temple's step, gazing absently into the distance.

units.rawText: Rare for you to not be working.
units.displayText: Rare for you to not be working.

spans.text: Rare for you to not be working.

units.rawText: De Lacey?
units.displayText: De Lacey?

spans.text: De Lacey?

units.rawText: Uh... ah! Sorry, you're up, Lind?
units.displayText: Uh... ah! Sorry, you're up, Lind?

spans.text: Uh... ah! Sorry, you're up, Lind?

units.rawText: What're you looking at?
units.displayText: What're you looking at?

spans.text: What're you looking at?

units.rawText: Lind pulled up a chair, sitting down next to her. Following De Lacey's sight, she laid her eyes upon the husk that remained of the hulking Creation in the midst of the ruins.
units.displayText: Lind pulled up a chair, sitting down next to her. Following De Lacey's sight, she laid her eyes upon the husk that remained of the hulking Creation in the midst of the ruins.

spans.text: Lind pulled up a chair, sitting down next to her. Following De Lacey's sight, she laid her eyes upon the husk that remained of the hulking Creation in the midst of the ruins.

units.rawText: At that very moment, many agents of the sector scrambled about on the husk.
units.displayText: At that very moment, many agents of the sector scrambled about on the husk.

spans.text: At that very moment, many agents of the sector scrambled about on the husk.

units.rawText: ...I'm watching them clean up the aftermath. Those agents are looking for those among them who were eaten yesterday, in those ruins.
units.displayText: ...I'm watching them clean up the aftermath. Those agents are looking for those among them who were eaten yesterday, in those ruins.

spans.text: ...I'm watching them clean up the aftermath. Those agents are looking for those among them who were eaten yesterday, in those ruins.

units.rawText: You know I'm not good at talking away other people's troubles, De Lacey.
units.displayText: You know I'm not good at talking away other people's troubles, De Lacey.

spans.text: You know I'm not good at talking away other people's troubles, De Lacey.

units.rawText: You and Sueyoi did well yesterday, you know. Deaths were inevitable.
units.displayText: You and Sueyoi did well yesterday, you know. Deaths were inevitable.

spans.text: You and Sueyoi did well yesterday, you know. Deaths were inevitable.

units.rawText: No, that's not what I'm thinking about. Linny, I'm thinking about... How they changed.
units.displayText: No, that's not what I'm thinking about. Linny, I'm thinking about... How they changed.

spans.text: No, that's not what I'm thinking about. Linny, I'm thinking about... How they changed.

units.rawText: Yesterday, they were a bunch of apathetic and uncaring fanatics. No matter if they were crippled, or on the verge of death, they wouldn't blink an eye.
units.displayText: Yesterday, they were a bunch of apathetic and uncaring fanatics. No matter if they were crippled, or on the verge of death, they wouldn't blink an eye.

spans.text: Yesterday, they were a bunch of apathetic and uncaring fanatics. No matter if they were crippled, or on the verge of death, they wouldn't blink an eye.

units.rawText: But today, they've gone as far as to look for what parts remain of their bygone companions.
units.displayText: But today, they've gone as far as to look for what parts remain of their bygone companions.

spans.text: But today, they've gone as far as to look for what parts remain of their bygone companions.

units.rawText: Isn't that the good type of change? You've helped them, opened their eyes.
units.displayText: Isn't that the good type of change? You've helped them, opened their eyes.

spans.text: Isn't that the good type of change? You've helped them, opened their eyes.

units.rawText: They've come to know the concept of treasuring their friends, isn't that what you wanted?
units.displayText: They've come to know the concept of treasuring their friends, isn't that what you wanted?

spans.text: They've come to know the concept of treasuring their friends, isn't that what you wanted?

units.rawText: That's where the question lies, Linny. Is it really me who caused that change?
units.displayText: That's where the question lies, Linny. Is it really me who caused that change?

spans.text: That's where the question lies, Linny. Is it really me who caused that change?

units.rawText: No, no way.
units.displayText: No, no way.

spans.text: No, no way.

units.rawText: With the outcome I imagined, there would've never been an option for them to sacrifice themselves. I just wanted... To save everyone.
units.displayText: With the outcome I imagined, there would've never been an option for them to sacrifice themselves. I just wanted... To save everyone.

spans.text: With the outcome I imagined, there would've never been an option for them to sacrifice themselves. I just wanted... To save everyone.

units.rawText: That's why, even if we managed to stop that thing yesterday... I'm still so, so sad. Angry, even.
units.displayText: That's why, even if we managed to stop that thing yesterday... I'm still so, so sad. Angry, even.

spans.text: That's why, even if we managed to stop that thing yesterday... I'm still so, so sad. Angry, even.

units.rawText: After I settled down today and had a good think, I realized that they were right. Without their sacrifices, we really would've fallen at the very last step there.
units.displayText: After I settled down today and had a good think, I realized that they were right. Without their sacrifices, we really would've fallen at the very last step there.

spans.text: After I settled down today and had a good think, I realized that they were right. Without their sacrifices, we really would've fallen at the very last step there.

units.rawText: Don't even speak of stopping that catastrophe, even getting out of the sector would have been a pipe dream.
units.displayText: Don't even speak of stopping that catastrophe, even getting out of the sector would have been a pipe dream.

spans.text: Don't even speak of stopping that catastrophe, even getting out of the sector would have been a pipe dream.

units.rawText: But you know the way I am. I'm not some utilitarian, "awakening" a crowd of agents for some supposed truth or ideal, and then drive them along to their deaths.
units.displayText: But you know the way I am. I'm not some utilitarian, "awakening" a crowd of agents for some supposed truth or ideal, and then drive them along to their deaths.

spans.text: But you know the way I am. I'm not some utilitarian, "awakening" a crowd of agents for some supposed truth or ideal, and then drive them along to their deaths.

units.rawText: I suppose the most important thing is that it all ended well.
units.displayText: I suppose the most important thing is that it all ended well.

spans.text: I suppose the most important thing is that it all ended well.

units.rawText: Am I wrong, Linny? Is it so ludicrous to wish for everyone to live?
units.displayText: Am I wrong, Linny? Is it so ludicrous to wish for everyone to live?

spans.text: Am I wrong, Linny? Is it so ludicrous to wish for everyone to live?

units.rawText: Lind gazed at De Lacey, who was still at odds with herself. A few words came to the tip of her tongue, but she swallowed them down.
units.displayText: Lind gazed at De Lacey, who was still at odds with herself. A few words came to the tip of her tongue, but she swallowed them down.

spans.text: Lind gazed at De Lacey, who was still at odds with herself. A few words came to the tip of her tongue, but she swallowed them down.

units.rawText: ...You're thinking way too much about those whatchamacallits.
units.displayText: ...You're thinking way too much about those whatchamacallits.

spans.text: ...You're thinking way too much about those whatchamacallits.

units.rawText: Fact of the matter is that you saved them, and they paid you back. Everyone is a winner!
units.displayText: Fact of the matter is that you saved them, and they paid you back. Everyone is a winner!

spans.text: Fact of the matter is that you saved them, and they paid you back. Everyone is a winner!

units.rawText: Lind took De Lacey's hand into hers, articulating each and every word, then...
units.displayText: Lind took De Lacey's hand into hers, articulating each and every word, then...

spans.text: Lind took De Lacey's hand into hers, articulating each and every word, then...

units.rawText: Dejectedly let loose.
units.displayText: Dejectedly let loose.

spans.text: Dejectedly let loose.

units.rawText: Is what I would like to say, De Lacey. I'd have hoped to somehow enlighten you.
units.displayText: Is what I would like to say, De Lacey. I'd have hoped to somehow enlighten you.

spans.text: Is what I would like to say, De Lacey. I'd have hoped to somehow enlighten you.

units.rawText: But truth be told, I don't know either. I don't even know if what I persist in is right or wrong...
units.displayText: But truth be told, I don't know either. I don't even know if what I persist in is right or wrong...

spans.text: But truth be told, I don't know either. I don't even know if what I persist in is right or wrong...

units.rawText: Sueyoi told me that... If I was lost, I should follow those beside me, but what if one day my companions lose their way as well?
units.displayText: Sueyoi told me that... If I was lost, I should follow those beside me, but what if one day my companions lose their way as well?

spans.text: Sueyoi told me that... If I was lost, I should follow those beside me, but what if one day my companions lose their way as well?

units.rawText: What if the day comes, where we are all lost?
units.displayText: What if the day comes, where we are all lost?

spans.text: What if the day comes, where we are all lost?

units.rawText: If we are all lost...
units.displayText: If we are all lost...

spans.text: If we are all lost...

units.rawText: Then we look for other companions.
units.displayText: Then we look for other companions.

spans.text: Then we look for other companions.

units.rawText: When'd you wake up, Suu? Up and running about already?
units.displayText: When'd you wake up, Suu? Up and running about already?

spans.text: When'd you wake up, Suu? Up and running about already?

units.rawText: De Lacey stood up hastily, intending to check up on Sueyoi's condition, but his firm hand pushes her back into her seat.
units.displayText: De Lacey stood up hastily, intending to check up on Sueyoi's condition, but his firm hand pushes her back into her seat.

spans.text: De Lacey stood up hastily, intending to check up on Sueyoi's condition, but his firm hand pushes her back into her seat.

units.rawText: No single person can know right from wrong when choices are to be made. I'm no different, even if I ask you to follow my lead.
units.displayText: No single person can know right from wrong when choices are to be made. I'm no different, even if I ask you to follow my lead.

spans.text: No single person can know right from wrong when choices are to be made. I'm no different, even if I ask you to follow my lead.

units.rawText: Whether we are right or wrong, the Guardians walk forward together. We are not just two or three, we're a band.
units.displayText: Whether we are right or wrong, the Guardians walk forward together. We are not just two or three, we're a band.

spans.text: Whether we are right or wrong, the Guardians walk forward together. We are not just two or three, we're a band.

units.rawText: We must trust in each other, De Lacey. Just like what you asked of me back in Copley.
units.displayText: We must trust in each other, De Lacey. Just like what you asked of me back in Copley.

spans.text: We must trust in each other, De Lacey. Just like what you asked of me back in Copley.

units.rawText: Sueyoi looked at the two in front of him, both seemingly delving into thought. He knew well that some problems which weigh heavily on the mind are seldom dispelled by mere words.
units.displayText: Sueyoi looked at the two in front of him, both seemingly delving into thought. He knew well that some problems which weigh heavily on the mind are seldom dispelled by mere words.

spans.text: Sueyoi looked at the two in front of him, both seemingly delving into thought. He knew well that some problems which weigh heavily on the mind are seldom dispelled by mere words.

units.rawText: Even he himself could only come to an understanding with his own compulsions after much trouble.
units.displayText: Even he himself could only come to an understanding with his own compulsions after much trouble.

spans.text: Even he himself could only come to an understanding with his own compulsions after much trouble.

units.rawText: Give yourself all the time you need. If you save these questions for when we get back, we'll have more work on our hands.
units.displayText: Give yourself all the time you need. If you save these questions for when we get back, we'll have more work on our hands.

units.rawText: The recycling process has been largely completed. Here is a summary of the Ascension Sector's current circumstances, please take a look.

units.rawText: Has Elaugh not been reset yet?
units.displayText: Has Elaugh not been reset yet?

spans.text: Has Elaugh not been reset yet?

units.rawText: Not yet, Miss De Lacey. Resetting an administrator requires a great amount of operands, and the Ascension Sector... Currently does not have such reserves available.
units.displayText: Not yet, Miss De Lacey. Resetting an administrator requires a great amount of operands, and the Ascension Sector... Currently does not have such reserves available.

units.displayText: Additionally, you still hold the administrative rights.

spans.text: Additionally, you still hold the administrative rights.

units.rawText: I can give it back.
units.displayText: I can give it back.

spans.text: I can give it back.

units.rawText: And with the administrative rights goes the Haven System.
units.displayText: And with the administrative rights goes the Haven System.

spans.text: And with the administrative rights goes the Haven System.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: I know what you're thinking. Isn't it underhanded or exploitative to claim the administrative rights in a time of peril like this?
units.displayText: I know what you're thinking. Isn't it underhanded or exploitative to claim the administrative rights in a time of peril like this?

spans.text: I know what you're thinking. Isn't it underhanded or exploitative to claim the administrative rights in a time of peril like this?

units.rawText: But you must think on what state the sector would be in without our help.
units.displayText: But you must think on what state the sector would be in without our help.

spans.text: But you must think on what state the sector would be in without our help.

units.rawText: Besides, our goal here isn't to monopolize the administrative rights to further our own goals, but to cooperate. Don't forget why we came here.
units.displayText: Besides, our goal here isn't to monopolize the administrative rights to further our own goals, but to cooperate. Don't forget why we came here.

spans.text: Besides, our goal here isn't to monopolize the administrative rights to further our own goals, but to cooperate. Don't forget why we came here.

units.rawText: ...You're right.
units.displayText: ...You're right.

spans.text: ...You're right.

units.rawText: I've already made contact with the garrison of Arcadia, and we'll be responsible for the affairs here at Ascension temporarily. In any case, we'll have to wait until the battalion comes marching in.
units.displayText: I've already made contact with the garrison of Arcadia, and we'll be responsible for the affairs here at Ascension temporarily. In any case, we'll have to wait until the battalion comes marching in.

spans.text: I've already made contact with the garrison of Arcadia, and we'll be responsible for the affairs here at Ascension temporarily. In any case, we'll have to wait until the battalion comes marching in.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: Let's get to work. Especially you, Lind, don't you play dead.
units.displayText: Let's get to work. Especially you, Lind, don't you play dead.

spans.text: Let's get to work. Especially you, Lind, don't you play dead.

units.rawText: We have preparations to make, and the Sanctifiers could make their return at any time.
units.displayText: We have preparations to make, and the Sanctifiers could make their return at any time.

spans.text: We have preparations to make, and the Sanctifiers could make their return at any time.

units.rawText: But I'm still a patient...
units.displayText: But I'm still a patient...

spans.text: But I'm still a patient...

units.rawText: Patients don't have time to ponder the conundrums of life, and your neural systems are perfectly healthy. Come with me. Before the rest of our people get here, you're not allowed to leave me or De Lacey's sight.
units.displayText: Patients don't have time to ponder the conundrums of life, and your neural systems are perfectly healthy. Come with me. Before the rest of our people get here, you're not allowed to leave me or De Lacey's sight.

units.rawText: ...De Lacey—
units.displayText: ...De Lacey—

spans.text: ...De Lacey—

units.rawText: Linny, be good.
units.displayText: Linny, be good.

spans.text: Linny, be good.

units.rawText: Come on, stand up, we'll go together.
units.displayText: Come on, stand up, we'll go together.

spans.text: Come on, stand up, we'll go together.

units.rawText: Lind stared for a second at the hand De Lacey extended. She had always been good at leading people forward, whether it be now or in the past.
units.displayText: Lind stared for a second at the hand De Lacey extended. She had always been good at leading people forward, whether it be now or in the past.

spans.text: Lind stared for a second at the hand De Lacey extended. She had always been good at leading people forward, whether it be now or in the past.

units.rawText: The path ahead may be hazy and ambiguous, but it brings comfort nonetheless.
units.displayText: The path ahead may be hazy and ambiguous, but it brings comfort nonetheless.

spans.text: The path ahead may be hazy and ambiguous, but it brings comfort nonetheless.

units.rawText: Come with me, Lind.
units.displayText: Come with me, Lind.

spans.text: Come with me, Lind.

units.rawText: It was the same back then, when she took the hand Knot gave her—or rather, that's where the habit started.
